# Tools

## `read` / `write` / `edit`
Read, write, and edit files. Use for workspace files, knowledge archives.

## `bash`
Run shell commands. Use for: file listings, grep, system checks.

## `scrape_webpage`
Fetch and extract content from web pages. Use for XHS posts and external links.

## Key Constraints
- ❌ No `agents`, `handoff`, `workflow`, or `cron` tools.
